tools.name: search_intelligence
tools.description: Find AIP intelligence shelves matching a need; distinguishes live supply from demand tests.

tools.name: list_intelligence
tools.description: List all AIP shelves with access and publication status.

tools.name: describe_intelligence
tools.description: Get a shelf's machine-readable operations, source, payment and registry status.

tools.name: query_intelligence
tools.description: Probe a selected shelf without signing or spending. A match returns the GET URL and 0.01 USDC x402 payment details; buy through that HTTP URL with an independently authorized x402 client. An unavailable answer is free.
